description: This PHP class 'RegistrationEmployeeTerminationEventProcessor' is part of the OrangeHRM system. It processes employee termination events by retrieving and handling counts of past employees to trigger certain registration events based on employee count thresholds.

classes.name: RegistrationEmployeeTerminationEventProcessor
classes.description: A class that handles processing of employee termination events, including determining the type of event, gathering employee count data, and deciding if an event should be saved based on employee count thresholds.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the event type represented as a constant value for employee inactivity count.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Gathers general registration event data, counts past employees, and adds this count to the event data array.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Decides whether the event should be saved based on whether the employee count crosses specified thresholds.
